other_conditions: Guardian of the bride/groom must be a native of Madhya Pradesh
Beneficiary must get marriage done only by participating in the group (mass) marriage program; single marriages are not eligible
Abandoned women who are legally divorced are eligible
Beneficiary should be a needy girl, widow, or abandoned sister
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to Rs. 55,000 (Rs. 11,000 to the bride’s account, Rs. 38,000 as a marriage gift, and Rs. 6,000 to the mass‑marriage organizing body) for eligible participants.
